scope: Read-only comparison of the complete old mesh inside arithmetic and new conditional nearest-triangle query; primitives remain literal original calls. No scientific definition or query/weights change.
equivalence_argument: Old signed mesh distance is +distance for insideFalse and -distance for insideTrue, where unsigned nearest-boundary distance is nonnegative. For positive frozen burial tolerance, insideFalse cannot satisfy signed<-tolerance. The new helper computes the identical complete local/halfspace inside array, leaves outside results false, and evaluates the original nearest_parts kernel with identical local coordinates and triangle order only for insideTrue; its predicate distance>tolerance is equivalent to -distance<-tolerance. Normals/point queries and all other old validity rules remain unchanged.
empirical_scope: 21 manufactured full-field calls including13 invalidity types and mixed mesh interior/boundary/exterior; nine original/static-perturbation records, complete fields/masks/scores/reference sites/weights/coverage exactly equal. This does not prove scientific mapping acceptance or global optimization.
